programs.title: The Flipping El Moussas
programs.desc: Tarek and Heather face the challenge of juggling both family and business! They look to take on a new flip all while planning Taylor's surprise 13th birthday party, and they're hoping to pull it all off without ending in a let down.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: After winning big on a scratcher, a California single mom is ready to leave her mobile home, job and old life behind for a new start in Las Vegas! David Bromstad is ready to show her three different locations to see which one is just right.

programs.title: Help! I Wrecked My House
programs.desc: A couple is now living in a house full of holes after he tackles a demo with no reno plans. Jasmine faces her most challenging floor plan yet and devises an unusual idea to open up their awkward home with a modern and bright California vibe.

programs.title: Down Home Fab
programs.desc: Chelsea and Cole take on a duo of tall dentists who aren't afraid to go bold; they push the boundaries with a modern-industrial kitchen and living room and a hotel-inspired bedroom with a daring open bathroom and double shower.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: Two theme park entertainers search for a home together in Orlando, Florida. They're looking for a place that can accommodate practicing their unique talent of stilt walking and aerialist abilities, but she wants to spend more than he wants.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A couple looks to relocate for his job and wants a home that feels posh near Bethesda, Maryland. He's hoping for a large yard like the one he had back home in Nigeria, but she's expecting a big house like their last place in Texas.

programs.title: Getaway
programs.desc: Getaway is Australia's favourite travel show with wonderful holiday ideas for all tastes and budgets as well as those once in a lifetime, dream destinations. Escape today with Getaway.

programs.title: Postcards
programs.desc: Bridget is in Queensland at a sheep dairy farm. Neary Ty visits a retro Chinese restaurant in Boronia. Brodie chats with the incredible team behind Cirque Du Soleil's Kooza. And Shane heads to Kilmore to learn the art of salami making.

programs.title: The Garden Gurus
programs.desc: The Garden Gurus is celebrating its 20th Anniversary! Trevor Cochrane and Neville Passmore reunite to kick off the Autumn 2022 series and to reminisce on their past Garden Gurus memories as well as share new stories and expertise.

programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: The heat is on as The Block's last rooms, the first floor and roof top terraces, are up for judging. This week the winning team gets to pocket the $10,000 all for themselves plus they have a big decision to make that could help them win.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Big Dreams, Tiny Budget in Freising, Germany
programs.desc: Disillusioned with the corporate grind, a young Canadian seeks a change in Freising, Germany. He has lofty expectations for his new home, but his grand housing aspirations may clash with the reality of a student budget.
